base: black-and-white editorial fine-art photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Minimal still-life composition, like a museum object photograph. The ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is a plain, smooth, light plaster wall, bright and empty, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subject small and dark, resting on the floor in the lower half of the frame, nothing entering from above. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter, no people, no face.

images.scene: On a bare concrete floor of an empty room against the plain plaster wall: three cardboard moving boxes, taped shut, stacked two and one beside, the top one open with its flaps up showing crumpled newspaper and old objects inside. The stack is low, entirely in the lower half of the frame, well below the middle. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: a pair of adult feet in worn flip-flops seen from behind at floor level, entering from the bottom edge, mid-step, and the person's long dark shadow stretching forward on the floor and up the base of the wall, attached to the feet. Only the feet and ankles are visible, low in the frame; the shadow stays below the middle of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low light from behind.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE old backpack, full and heavy, set down on the floor but still strapped by one strap to a hand and forearm that enters from the right edge at floor level, as if the person cannot let go of it. Small, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.
